profile_text: As a leading provider of legal and tax advisory services, this Düsseldorf-based firm has experienced significant growth, with a 35.6% increase in employees since the baseline, driven by its expertise in supporting businesses with complex legal and tax matters. With 400 employees in 2024, the company's specialized services are in high demand, fueling its expansion as a scaler in the professional services sector. Its partnership structure, combining legal and tax expertise, enables the firm to offer comprehensive solutions to its clients.
